fusions.name: Sandbox Pod
fusions.desc: Fires a ripe seed pod that bursts on the first enemy it meets, dealing 34 damage, and 80% of that to every other enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Seed Buckshot
fusions.desc: Fires 3 hard seeds at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pod Battery
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to grow a seed-spitting pod beside you for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires on an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage.

fusions.name: Swelling Seedcase
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
